summary: Review C passes at d74cf4c. The delta closes RA-1, RA-3, RA-4, and RA-5 as spec D16 and D18 require. The fresh preview shows plain names in the overview pick and second cells. The CLI usage lines and the refusal lines match spec D16 Tool details. The guide, update, and preview-gate suites pass with 17, 9, and 99 tests. Four nonblocking items remain: a stale 10-run sentence in the overview lede, a Phase 5 render gap, a 0.00 value for a row with no runs, and an AC4 wording conflict.
nonblocking_findings: RC2-1 [Major] harness/model-guide/pages/guide-section.html:4-6 | The lede of the overview says 'A model needs 10 runs or more, or a complete review rank.' Spec D18 (spec.md:1017-1024) and the header of guide.ts (guide.ts:56-58) set the minimum at 5 tasks or 5 runs, and page B says 5 (real-work.html:121). The text predates the delta (commit 61c99c1) and no test pins it. The page contradicts its own pick rule for a row with 5 to 9 tasks. | Fix scope: change one sentence in guide-section.html to the D18 rule and add one test pin. Do it before the first publish (D21).

RC2-2 [Major] harness/model-guide/update.sh:132-134, harness/model-guide/preview.sh:279-284 and :746-791 | Outside the delta. Phase 5 scope. After approval, update.sh writes docs/assets/data/real-work.json and model-guide.json. preview.sh renders real-work.html and the overview table as static HTML, and the two templates hold no script. No site script reads the two JSON files (docs/assets/js/site.js:23 and :112 fetch only tracks.json and benchmark.json). The preview folder holds both JSON files at its root, not in assets/data. A weekly update therefore changes files that no page reads, and the stale mark of D19 can never show on a published page. Found by code trace and grep, not by a run. | Fix scope: the owner of spec D19, D21, and plan tasks 5.3 and 5.4 chooses one path: pages that read the JSON at load, or a re-render step in update.sh with the page paths in the commit. No change in 4.1e or 4.1f.

RC2-3 [Nit] harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:517 | A checker row with 0 decided runs gets findings_per_run 0, so the page shows 0.00 for it (the hy4-flash-free row in the Too few tasks group of the checker table). Spec D16 says an empty value shows a dash. The line predates the delta. | Fix scope: write null when decided is 0. preview.sh:473-476 already maps a non-number to the dash. Check first that no test pins 0.00 for a zero-run row.

RC2-4 [Nit] measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:1271-1273 | Acceptance 4 says a row with the mark 'not for verdicts' never picks. D16 Top block (spec.md:902-910) and D18 Pick rule (spec.md:1017-1024) apply the net-score filter to gate rows only. The page follows D16 and D18: the Red pick DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (net score 0.9) and the Green pick MiMo V2.6 Flash (net score -10.83) carry the mark in the producer table and still pick. A literal reading of acceptance 4 fails the page. | Fix scope: spec wording only, for example add 'in a gate row' to acceptance 4. No code change.

ratings.evidence: The preview at /tmp/rc2-preview shows plain names in the overview cells and every RA-3 probe exits 2 with 'input-check: manifest <name>', but guide-section.html:4-6 states a 10-run minimum and real-work.ts:517 gives 0.00 for a zero-run row.

The RA-3 cases in input-check.test.ts and the RA-1 and RA-2 cases in guide.test.ts pin each fix and pass (guide 17, update 9, preview-gate 99), but no test pins the overview lede text or the dash for a zero-run row.
